dict.string: muesli records your microphone so it can transcribe your side of a conversation. Audio is processed on-device.
muesli records system audio so it can transcribe the other participants in a call or meeting. Audio is processed on-device.
muesli adds the action items from your meetings to Reminders, only after you approve them.
muesli adds events agreed in your meetings to Calendar, only after you approve them, and can remove what it added.
muesli transcribes audio on-device using Apple's speech recognition.
